boundaries: This one domain owns all CFA PDF extraction; there are no lane splits. Coordinate through the supplied inventory and your SESSION.json, never by inventing sub-domains.
Batch IDs name the PDF: financial-analysis-cfa-l1-b1-b01, b02, ... for CFA Level 1 book 1 (use the level/book from your source manifest; lowercase slugs only).

Do not resubmit the 14 covered TVM-family IDs as new coverage: lump-sum-future-value-discrete, ordinary-annuity-future-value, annuity-due-future-value, annuity-due-present-value, growing-annuity-present-value, effective-annual-rate-nominal, periodic-rate-from-nominal, effective-discount-rate, level-loan-periodic-payment, loan-payment-interest-portion, loan-payment-principal-portion, arithmetic-gradient-annual-equivalent, constant-growth-stock-present-value, fisher-real-rate (all under engineering-finance--). Record overlaps instead; genuinely distinct variants need their own sources and overlap notes.
CFA ethics/standards material is out of scope: no quantifiable relationships, no curation.

Out of engine reach means defer, never approximate: iterative solvers (IRR/YTM by iteration), normal-CDF forms (Black-Scholes), regressions needing estimation. log, log10, exp, sqrt, sum, prod, len and index families are available forward-only.
No investment advice, forecasts, or recommendations anywhere in records; records are mathematical formalizations with scope and provenance.
coverage_guidance: Work the PDF cover to cover in reading order so nothing is skipped; queue at least ten candidates ahead from upcoming readings. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Manifest the PDF (filename, SHA-256, level, book) in SESSION.json before the first batch. Quantifiable content anywhere in the PDF is in scope even when no priority names it; the mission sentence governs, priorities only seed the queue. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
integration_expectation: Most finance meanings are new and require extension; preserve them and mark requires-extension. Never relabel a return as a discount rate, a variance as a price, or a yield as a probability to force execution. Period counts stay dimensionless; physical durations use duration.
mission: Systematically extract every quantifiable relationship, definition, and closed-form equation from the CFA PDF named in your dispatch (one PDF per worker session unless told otherwise), as atomic reusable financial-analysis records. Cover the whole book in reading order: quantitative methods, financial reporting, corporate finance, equity, fixed income, derivatives, alternatives, and portfolio management. Each record carries its exact PDF locator plus independent corroboration from a directly inspected accessible source.
priorities: Time value of money: lump sums, ordinary and due annuities, growing annuities, perpetuities, and effective/nominal rate conversions with stated timing and compounding
Return definitions: holding-period, arithmetic/geometric mean, time-weighted vs money-weighted, and annualization with explicit frequency
Risk and statistics for finance: variance, standard deviation, covariance, correlation, z-scores, and regression closed forms with population/sample scope
Fixed income: price/yield closed forms, duration and convexity measures, and spot/forward rate identities with stated compounding
Equity and corporate finance: dividend discount and free-cash-flow forms, cost-of-capital identities, leverage ratios, and working-capital arithmetic
Derivatives and portfolio basics: no-arbitrage forward/futures pricing, put-call parity, and mean-variance portfolio arithmetic where closed-form
Financial-statement arithmetic: ratio definitions (liquidity, solvency, profitability, activity) with exact numerator/denominator scope from the source
special_checks: Canonical base units: never inline a conversion factor the unit scales already encode (percent/decimal, annual/monthly); factors live in constants metadata or translation notes, never in the expression.
Financial periods are dimensionless counts and never convert to physical seconds; physical durations use duration.
No implicit currency conversion: amounts in different currencies never mix without an explicit rate model; nominal/real basis is part of the context.
Guard the math the source requires: positive rates/principal, growth-below-rate for Gordon-type forms, nonzero denominators, stated timing (beginning/end of period) and compounding frequency.
Keep probability, odds, return, rate, and yield meanings distinct; a number in [0,1] is not automatically any one of them.
starter_sources: Your assigned PDF under sources/ (read it directly; record printed page AND PDF page, reading/section, and equation or exhibit number for every record).

A directly inspected accessible corroborating source per record (public textbook, official documentation, agency/standards page); record exact book, edition, section and access date, never cite a root URL as evidence.
